scope: Controlled native functional observations with three selected capable zero-point founders, empty stores, actual generated resources, native meal payments and crop/coppice regrowth. Excludes natural founder selection, player work and long-term Survival rates. GameTest executes native ticks faster than wall time. Geometry/stock evidence is in WildWorksGameTest and art/wild_glade/. Fresh rest-plot revision: controlled transactions prove all three paid Nests, with explicitly advanced crop age. Native walking/growth/ration/night scenarios prove the first claimed paid Nest plus the original furnace/lights; they do not certify all-three or natural multi-generation continuity. Ordinary-helper first-litter references freeze three Genome.DEFAULT founders instead of the elite selected profile; all retain zero points and empty initial learning. Native crop growth, meals, walking, courtship, soil planting and hatch remain real. These references do not measure natural random-founder Survival rates. Current primitive-camp revision begins with zero usable inventory, real ground supplies/meals and paid three-plank cache installation; old empty-store observations remain historical. Four original logs produce sixteen planks, covering the fifteen-plank initial cache/tool bill. Native recipe lookup distinguishes the three-plank cache from vanilla table.
